Tidy converted Markdown for Quarto

clean_markdown.Rd

Fixes things that Word and PowerPoint leave behind after convert_markdown(), so the Markdown works in Quarto. Each fix is optional:

  • removes stray escaping from citations,

  • moves headings down a level, for all headings or for PowerPoint slides under a section,

  • turns draft blocks written by replace_placeholders() back into their placeholders, ready to fill again,

  • removes Word styling and formatting from placeholders.

Usage

clean_markdown(
  markdown_file = "markdown_output.md",
  clean_citations = FALSE,
  pptx_section_offset = FALSE,
  heading_offset = FALSE,
  clear_draft = FALSE,
  draft_mode_prefix = "DRAFT_CONTENT_START",
  draft_mode_suffix = "DRAFT_CONTENT_END",
  clear_placeholder_styling = TRUE,
  placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_",
  output_file = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

markdown_file

Path to the Markdown file to clean.

clean_citations

Logical. If TRUE, remove the backslashes Pandoc adds to citations, so \[@key\] becomes [@key]. Defaults to FALSE.

pptx_section_offset

Logical. If TRUE, move each heading that has body text under it down one level (to a maximum of 6). For slides, this keeps Section Header slides at the top level and puts the slides beneath them. Defaults to FALSE.

heading_offset

Logical. If TRUE, move every heading down one level (to a maximum of 6), so a Word "Heading 1" doesn't become the page title in HTML. Applied after pptx_section_offset. Defaults to FALSE.

clear_draft

Logical. If TRUE, replace each draft block with the placeholder it was filled from, ready for replace_placeholders() to fill again. placeholder_prefix must match the one used to fill the draft: otherwise no placeholder is found and the draft content is removed with nothing to refill. Defaults to FALSE.

draft_mode_prefix, draft_mode_suffix

The lines that start and end a draft block. Defaults to "DRAFT_CONTENT_START" and "DRAFT_CONTENT_END". Avoid --, which Word turns into a dash.

clear_placeholder_styling

Logical. If TRUE (the default), remove the Word style and any bold, italic, superscript or subscript from placeholders, so [placeholder_total]{custom-style="PlaceholderMarker"} becomes placeholder_total. Only placeholders are changed.

placeholder_prefix

The text every placeholder starts with, used exactly as given. The placeholder is the prefix followed by the ID, so the default "placeholder_" with the ID plot gives placeholder_plot. Choose any prefix that won't appear by accident in normal writing, such as "knit_" or "xyz_". Use the same prefix in clean_markdown() and replace_placeholders(). Defaults to "placeholder_".

output_file

Path to write the result to, leaving markdown_file unchanged. Defaults to NULL, which overwrites markdown_file.

overwrite

Logical. If FALSE, stop rather than write over an existing file. Defaults to TRUE. Use timestamped_path() to keep earlier versions.

Value

The cleaned lines, invisibly.

See also

Other workflow: convert_markdown(), replace_placeholders(), run_workflow()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# After converting a Word document for the first time
clean_markdown(
  "draft.md",
  placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_",
  heading_offset = TRUE,
  clean_citations = TRUE
)

# After the writer has edited a filled draft
clean_markdown(
  "draft.md",
  placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_",
  clear_draft = TRUE
)
} # }
